### ✅ Submitter Checklist

Please confirm the following before requesting review:

- [ ] I have assigned myself to this PR.
- [ ] I have applied the correct label(s), such as `WIP` or `REVIEW-NEEDED`.
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and resolved all warnings and errors.
- [ ] I have run `npm run build` and confirmed the app builds successfully.
- [ ] I have removed unnecessary console logs, commented code, and debug leftovers.
- [ ] This PR does not contain hardcoded credentials or sensitive data.
- [ ] I have manually tested the feature or bugfix in the target environment.
- [ ] I have verified that affected areas of the app still work as expected.

### 🔍 Reviewer Checklist

Please confirm the following before approving:

- [ ] I have read all code changes and left comments or approved explicitly.
- [ ] The code was tested and functionality is confirmed locally or through CI.
- [ ] The implementation matches the task description and does not exceed scope.
- [ ] Code style and structure follow project conventions.
- [ ] There are no obvious performance issues or major bottlenecks introduced.
- [ ] There are no security concerns or potential data leaks.
- [ ] Test coverage appears sufficient for the scope of changes.
- [ ] Public users cannot access unpublished product data.
- [ ] Admin-only behavior is protected server-side, not only hidden in the UI.
- [ ] This PR is safe to merge and should not cause regressions or side effects.
